name: Mutammim ibn Nuwayra
bio: Mutammim ibn Nuwayra was a notable of the Yarbu branch of Tamim who lived before and after the rise of Islam. His brother Malik was killed in the wars following the Prophet’s death. The elegies are as attentive to the man who must now live among Malik’s people as they are to the brother they have lost. Al-Yazidi relates that Umar asked Mutammim to recite for him and questioned him about Malik. Mutammim lived in Medina during Umar’s caliphate, and al-Zirikli places his death around 30 AH (650 CE).
